title: Concept: Vue v-html directive in served markup
description: A Vue template that binds HTML through the v-html directive in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: v-html inserts its value as markup instead of text, so a bound value that carries user content becomes executable; the directive in a served template marks the exact injection point.
applicability: Any attacker-controlled string that reaches the directive executes in the page's origin.
risk: Vue escapes interpolated text; v-html is the explicit opt-out.
